jobPostingInfo.title: Sourcing Manager
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role:

As a Sourcing Manager, you will play a crucial role in executing sourcing processes for electromechanical components, managing supplier relationships, and driving cost efficiencies. The focus will be on strategic sourcing and supplier management, including negotiations, contracting, and supplier performance. You will need to collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with company goals and market trends.


Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

- Manage sourcing for electronic mechanical components.

- Oversee supplier management and negotiate pricing and contracts.

- Lead new supplier selection and vendor management.

- Drive cost reduction strategies and identify sourcing opportunities.

- Collaborate with internal teams to provide market trend analysis.

- Develop and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and partners.

- Ensure business continuity and risk mitigation strategies are in place.


Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

- At least 3-4 years of sourcing experience, especially in components.

- High proficiency in English, both spoken and written.

- Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.

- Ability to work globally across regions (US, EMEA, AP).

- Experience in strategic sourcing and international procurement.

- Ability to understand market drivers and cost structures.

- Strong interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.

- Proven track record in supplier and cost management.

- Knowledge of financial analysis related to sourcing.


#LI-RD1

jobPostingInfo.title: Head of Global Commercial Business Finance Operations
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Job title: Director, Head of Global Commercial Business Finance Operations


Reports to: Sr Director, Head of Global Commercial Sales Finance & Business Finance Operations


Location: Cork (IE), Lausanne (CH), Utrecht (NL), London (UK)


Role Overview:

The Head of Global Commercial Business Finance Operations is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving operational efficiency, process transformation, sales performance management and strategic initiatives within the company's Global Commercial Organization (GCO). This individual will serve as a key business partner to the Commercial Finance team in the regions and GCO leadership team, providing business insights, leading business operations functions, and ensuring the GCO operates effectively and achieves its revenue and profitability targets globally. This role requires a blend of strong financial acumen, operational expertise, strategic thinking and cross-functional leadership.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Sales Performance Management: Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to global sales effectiveness, productivity, pipeline conversion, and sales efficiency. Analyze performance, identify trends and variances, and provide actionable insights to GCO leadership.
  • Sales Compensation and Incentive Planning: Sitting in Commercial Incentives Committee, partner with Sales leadership and HR to design, implement, and analyze global sales compensation plans and incentive structures to drive desired sales behaviors and outcomes. Ensure alignment with financial targets and business strategy.
  • Pricing Strategy Implementation: Support the implementation and execution of the company's global pricing strategies and structure. Establish and enforce global pricing rules and floors for special pricing, global/regional deals, ensuring effectiveness and alignment with policy / internal controls.
  • Pricing Process Development and Management: Develop, document, and manage global pricing processes, including price list creation, discounting guidelines, approval workflows, and pricing communication to the sales team. 
  • Pricing Tools and Systems: Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of pricing tools and systems to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and ease of use for the sales organization.
  • Channel Revenue Management:  Oversee global Channel revenue and Gross to Net process and tool management. Lead day to day operation of spend entry, quarter end close and process/tool improvement. Manage the communication across the entire GCO for the spend guidance, process and ongoing enhancements.
  • SOX Control and Compliance Oversight: Serve as the Business Process Owner (BPO) for critical sales operations SOX controls. Ensure the integrity of the global SOX environment by maintaining and enforcing transactional approval matrices and financial thresholds within systems
  • Sales Operations Leadership: Oversee key global sales operations functions, including POS data management, sales reporting and analytics, territory management, and quota administration. Drive efficiency and effectiveness in sales execution.
  • Business Finance Process Transformation: Identify and lead initiatives to streamline and improve business finance processes across the global organization. Drive automation and best practices adoption to enhance SOX compliance and reduce complexity
  • Team Leadership and Development: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team encompassing both sales operations professionals and transformation task forces within Finance across global regions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with global Finance organizations (including accounting and FP&A), Legal, IT and other departments to ensure alignment and support the GCO's objectives.
  • Strategic Project Management: Lead and manage strategic projects and initiatives within the GCO or Business Finance (such as GtN optimization), ensuring they are aligned with business goals and delivered effectively.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor or Master degree in Finance, Accounting, Audit, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or relevant advanced degree is highly preferred.
  • Minimum of 20 years of progressive experience in both finance and sales operations, with significant experience in a leadership role within a global organization.
  • Deep understanding of sales processes, sales compensation models, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and sales data management.
  • Proven track record of driving global process transformation, financial performance and operational improvements within a global sales organization.
  • Experience in audit, internal control including design, implement and enhancement will be a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to effectively interact with senior sales leadership.
  • Proven leadership and team management skills, with experience building and managing cross-functional teams across geographies.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in CRM, sales analytics tools, and financial operation systems.

Personal Attributes:

  • Strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong understanding of the sales operation function and commercial finance.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven in decision-making.
  • Excellent communicator and influencer, able to build credibility with sales leaders.
  • Strong collaborator and team player.
  • Proactive and takes initiative to identify and solve problems.
  • Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic global sales environment.
  • High integrity and ethical standards.

jobPostingInfo.title: Head of Commercial & GTM PWS BG
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Mission:

We are seeking a highly strategic and commercially experienced leader to shape and accelerate the global commercial and go-to-market agenda for Logitech’s Personal Workspace Solutions (PWS) business.

In this highly visible global role, with stakeholders across organisations, functions and levels, you will strongly influence the PWS strategic agenda and work closely with business unit partners, central marketing, regions and global leadership to drive key PWS strategies, annual planning and identify key commercial business opportunities that help PWS grow faster in a more effective way.


What You’ll Do:


  • Shape Global Commercial & GTM Strategy: Drive and co-ordinate PWS global B2C commercial and go-to-market strategies, priorities, and KPIs, in close collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Lead Global Business Planning (within Business Group): Own the annual PWS business planning process within the Business Group (together with Finance) and in close collaboration with the regions, translating strategic ambitions into clear priorities, investments and execution plans.
  • Drive Commercial Performance: Centrally lead analysis of business performance across categories and channels. Identify the drivers behind growth, market share or execution gaps and turn insights into clear action plans.
  • Set Priorities & Investment Choices: Determine where PWS should focus resources and spending to maximize growth and commercial impact (in close collaboration across departments and organisations).
  • Benchmark & Scale What Works: Lead the establishment of global benchmarking across key commercial KPIs, identify winning practices and drive their reapplication across regions.
  • Connect Global, Category & Regional Teams: Act as the overarching X-PWS commercial point of contact for Logitech’s six regions, helping solve X-PWS commercial and GTM issues..
  • Lead Executive Business Reviews: Lead total PWS commercial performance reviews and quarterly business updates, translating complex performance into clear insights, choices and actions.

Who You Are:

We’re looking for someone who embodies our values: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment.You also bring:


  • 15+ years of experience in commercial, go-to-market, business management leadership roles.
  • Experience in blue chip companies in FMCG, Consumer Electronics, Retail, Lifestyle or other fast-moving global B2C environments 
  • A proven track record of managing complex businesses ideally globally or at least across multiple regions and across multiple categories or portfolios.
  • Strong P&L and commercial acumen, with a deep understanding of revenue, growth, market share, profitability and investment choices.
  • Exceptional strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to move quickly from data and complexity to the clear insights and actions that matter.
  • Demonstrated success navigating a global matrix organization, influencing senior stakeholders and aligning teams across functions and geographies.
  • Experience operating in highly competitive environments, diagnosing commercial performance issues and building pragmatic growth or defense plans.
  • Strong prioritization and decision-making skills, combined with a highly collaborative and influential leadership style.
  • Significant international experience and fluency in English. Strong executive presence, comfortable presenting business insights and recommendations to C-level leaders. 

#LI-MT1

jobPostingInfo.title: Sr. Procurement Manager
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Hybrid role - 2 days per week on site.

Sr. Procurement Manager – Indirect Procurement


We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sr. Procurement Manager to join our Indirect Procurement organization. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to senior business leaders, including C-suite and executive stakeholders, helping shape how the organization manages third-party spend and creates sustainable business value.


You will own and lead strategic sourcing and category management initiatives across key areas of indirect spend, challenging established ways of working, identifying new opportunities, and bringing innovative procurement solutions to the business.


This role combines strategic thinking, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and strong execution. You will use market intelligence, data analytics, enterprise AI, and data storytelling to turn complex spend and market insights into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnering & Stakeholder Influence

  • Act as a trusted procurement advisor to C-suite and senior business leaders, providing strategic insights, commercial recommendations, and opportunities to optimize third-party spend.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across functions, developing a deep understanding of business priorities, challenges, and growth plans.
  • Proactively challenge existing practices and assumptions, bringing external market perspectives, innovative solutions, and best-in-class procurement thinking to the organization.
  • Influence decision-making at the highest levels, balancing business requirements, commercial objectives, risk, and long-term value.
  • Partner with stakeholders to build procurement strategies that are aligned with broader business and functional objectives.


Category Management & Strategic Sourcing

  • Develop and execute comprehensive category strategies across key indirect spend areas such as IT, Marketing, Professional Services, HR, Facilities, and other corporate services.
  • Lead complex, high-value sourcing initiatives from opportunity identification and market analysis through to sourcing, negotiation, contracting, implementation, and benefits realization.
  • Develop category roadmaps that identify opportunities for cost savings, cost avoidance, value creation, supplier optimization, risk mitigation, and process improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional sourcing teams, bringing together business stakeholders, Finance, Legal, and other relevant functions to deliver strategic outcomes.
  • Establish a strong understanding of supplier markets, emerging trends, cost drivers, and competitive dynamics to inform category strategies and sourcing decisions.
  • Ensure sourcing and category initiatives deliver sustainable results that are tracked, measured, and communicated to stakeholders.


Data, AI & Procurement Transformation

  • Leverage procurement data, analytics, and enterprise AI capabilities to identify opportunities, improve decision-making, and increase procurement effectiveness.
  • Use data storytelling to translate complex spend, supplier, and market information into clear, compelling recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and transform procurement processes through technology, AI, and innovative ways of working.
  • Establish fact-based business cases that demonstrate the financial and strategic impact of procurement initiatives.
  • Contribute to the continued evolution of the Indirect Procurement function, helping establish scalable, data-driven, and digitally enabled ways of working.


Commercial Value & Supplier Management

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, ensuring procurement strategies deliver competitive pricing, favorable contractual terms, and broader business value.
  • Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships, balancing performance, innovation, commercial value, resilience, and risk.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate spend, improve supplier performance, optimize commercial models, and unlock additional value.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to ensure savings and other procurement benefits are accurately measured, validated, and sustained.
  • Monitor category and supplier performance, proactively addressing risks and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.


Leadership & Procurement Excellence

  • Lead through influence, bringing structure, pace, and accountability to complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Mentor and support procurement colleagues, sharing category expertise, commercial best practices, and strategic sourcing capabilities.
  • Represent Indirect Procurement as a strategic business function, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and value creation.
  • Contribute to procurement-wide initiatives and transformation programs beyond individual category responsibilities.
